evidence: Saves the caller output pointer, reads the global context entry, and performs two separate nested-attribute lookups with selector 0x1c. Each lookup calls nested_attribute_provider_get_float and converts the float result to a signed integer; the first is stored and the second is added to it before return (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:24842-24876; helper decompiled/main/main_0170.c:13026-13045). No indexed callers are available.

Initializes a local context value, requires the first helper check and context_status_id_0x48_is_positive to pass, bounds the selector to 0..0x22, and tests its bit against two masks. Depending on those mask and helper predicates, it invokes one of two helpers that dispatch through object callbacks at offsets +0x58 or +0x60; otherwise it returns through the fallback helper (decompiled/main/main_0092.c:33723-33760; status helper decompiled/main/main_0006.c:33897-33909; callback dispatch helpers main_0092.c:29772-29798). No indexed callers are available.

Queries aggregate_related_attribute_values with selector 0x28 and arguments 2,0,0 using the primary context; if that result is positive it writes 1 to the caller output. Otherwise it repeats the same aggregate query using a second context and writes whether that result is positive (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:8320-8353; aggregate helper decompiled/main/main_0170.c:56000-56156). Indexed callers pass the output pointer and source object at decompiled/main/main_0112.c:7814-7818 in caller f_7000f832a0; no higher-level meaning is established.

Returns -2 when the object flag at +0x42a is clear or when attribute-context selector 0x13 reports status 6 or 7. For allowed statuses, it returns 1 for the input value above 99, 0 for values 1 through 99, and -2 for nonpositive values (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:37730-37776; status helper decompiled/main/main_0093.c:48967-49067). The indexed caller passes the input value at decompiled/main/main_0112.c:7814-7818 in f_7000f832a0.

When the flag argument is clear, it returns the float at input+0x10. When set, it reads a global scalar, substitutes 1.0 if that global pointer is absent, and otherwise passes the value through status checking and linear_remap_clamped before additional flag-dependent float selection; the exact returned domain and role are not established, so left unnamed (decompiled/main/main_0029.c:17892-17934; remap helper decompiled/main/main_0144.c:37800-37835). Indexed callers provide an object and flag at decompiled/main/main_0094.c:15090-15094 and decompiled/main/main_0149.c:14088-14092.
